cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Credit for the Impossible
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge that you understood, predicted, or accepted the impossible truth before anyone else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put my finger to my lips like you. A little respect for its first believer. I backed this cupboard before it could speak.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cupboard's asking for silence, not a speech.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. One quick acknowledgment from you, then I'll be quiet.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It says you talk too much.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell it those were years of encouragement, before anyone else would listen to it.

reason: Copied hush becomes supposed tribute to A early belief; B object complaint causes A to ask for acknowledgment of long support rather than merely summarize it.
